h:
非常快速且简单的 XY Plot 工作流程，您可以将其复制到任何其他工作流程中以方便使用（并且它本身也能很好地工作）

先决条件

  • ComfyUI 管理器 (https://github.com/ltdrdata/ComfyUI-Manager)

  • Mile High 造型器 (https://civitai.com/models/119246/sdxl-mile-high-prompt-styler-the-big-one-this-update-breaks-workflows-read-description-on-how-to-fix)

  • 效率节点（https://github.com/LucianoCirino/efficiency-nodes-comfyui)

用途

  • 在 Sampler + Styler 中，添加正面/负面提示并选择要应用的样式

  • 调整其上方的任何 KSampler 属性

  • 在 X/Y 输入中，更改/添加您想要在网格中查看结果的内容（检查点、采样器、步骤等）

错误说明和解决方法

用户界面中存在一个已识别的错误，其中嵌套文本提示/样式器虽然允许您轻松过滤样式，但即使在嵌套时提供不同的提示，这些值也会保留。例如

  • 不嵌套时，会出现提示“男孩吃樱桃派”，然后嵌套它

  • 新提示是空白的，因此您提示“女孩与朋友交谈”，当您渲染时，它仍然会渲染“男孩吃樱桃派”

节点开发人员目前正在研究此错误。

解决方法：取消嵌套提示以提供新提示（并且您将需要滚动到您选择的样式）。我们很快就会有更新版本。

o.en:
Very quick and easy XY Plot workflow that you can copy into any other workflow for easy use (and it works great on its own as well)

PREREQUISITES

  • ComfyUI Manager (https://github.com/ltdrdata/ComfyUI-Manager)

  • Mile High Styler (https://civitai.com/models/119246/sdxl-mile-high-prompt-styler-the-big-one-this-update-breaks-workflows-read-description-on-how-to-fix)

  • Efficiency Nodes (https://github.com/LucianoCirino/efficiency-nodes-comfyui)

USAGE

  • In Sampler + Styler, add your positive/negative prompt and optionally choose a style to apply

  • Adjust any KSampler attributes above it

  • In X/Y Inputs, change/add what you want to see results in the grid by (checkpoint, sampler, steps, etc.)

BUG NOTE AND WORKAROUND

There is an identified bug in the user interface where the nested text prompt/styler though it will allow you to filter styles easily, the values will persist even if when nested you provide a different prompt. For example

  • When not nested you have a prompt "Boy eating cherry pie" and then you nest it

  • The new prompt is blank so you prompt "Girl talking with friends" and when you render, it'll still render "Boy eating cherry pie"

This bug is currently being looked at by the node developers.

Workaround: Un-nest the prompt to provide new prompts (and you will need to scroll to the style of your choice). We'll have an updated version soon.
